names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 decembrie, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Eustratie», with the rank words left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ευστράτιος, Αυξέντιος, Ευγένιος, Μαρδάριος και Ορέστης», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name itself, «(από ευ + στρατός) = ο αρχηγός ένδοξου στρατού».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 13. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученици Евстратије, Аксентије, Евгеније, Мардарије и Орест.“ — with «Свети мученици» left off, that being “holy” and the grade `types` keeps, and the first of the five bare forenames taken; the heading gives the five nothing but their names, and the Arabraca of this folder’s display name is in the body. THE FOLD THIS MAKES IS WRITTEN AND KEYED: `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the string at one other holder, `eustratius-of-mount-olympus`, and no READ_FOLDS key existed, so a new two-member key goes into `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this commit.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 decembrie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Eustratie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ευστράτιος, Αυξέντιος, Ευγένιος, Μαρδάριος και Ορέστης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the corpus already keeps for the company, and the entry is the same five: the officer Eustratius and his fellows under Diocletian. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page names Λυσίας the duke and Ἀγρικόλας the eparch as their judges, and gives no year for the persecution beyond «επί Διοκλητιανού», so no `dates` are proposed from it. It lists at length where the relics are kept — Μεγίστη Λαύρα, Κουτλουμούσι, Ξηροπόταμος, Φιλοθέου, Καρακάλου and Κύκκου, Μικρόκαστρο of Siatista, Αρχάγγελος Μιχαήλ at Aridaia, and the greater part of all five at the church of the Holy Trinity and the Five Martyrs at Πολύστυλο of Kavala — which is not drafted. **A second entry on the same day page, «Όσιος Μαρδάριος ο Έγκλειστος» of the Lavra of the Caves, carries the same personal name as one of these five and is a different man; it is drafted as a new folder, `mardarius-the-recluse`.** The page prints an apolytikion naming all five, which is taken into each of the five folders, a kontakion naming Eustratius alone, which is taken into his, and a kathisma and an oikos, which are kinds the schema does not hold.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 26.12.2025 (13. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Евстратије, Аксентије, Евгеније, Мардарије и Орест.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, AN ENUMERATED FIVE, so BRIEF-SERBIAN §5 counts five and each of the five folders takes this one heading whole with its closing full stop; the corpus holds all five and they are already `related` to one another in every direction. URL year 2025. He is the first name. `types` UNTOUCHED: «мученици» is the grade of which the folder holds the fuller `great-martyr`, which is the other two calendars’ word, and `soldier` is confirmed in so many words — «Евстратије свети беше римски војвода у граду Саталиону», a Roman commander. **THE BOOK PUTS HIM IN THE CITY THIS CORPUS GIVES TO ANOTHER OF THE SAME FIVE.** It makes him commander in САТАЛИОН, which is the Satala of `eugene-of-satala`’s display name, and says in the same breath that he and Mardarius were both from АРАВРАКИН, which is the Arabraca of his own. So the two cities the corpus has used to tell two of the five apart are, in this book, one man’s post and one man’s birthplace. NOTHING WAS RENAMED, no `locations` key was made, and both readings are in the life. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT: the entry names the emperors Диоклецијан and Максимијан and the governors Лисије and Агрикола and gives none of them years. `related_add`: `blaise-of-sebaste`, in both directions, because the entry says «Пред смрт причести светог Евстратија у тамници свети Власије (в. 11. фебруар)» — before his death Saint Blaise communed him in prison, with the book’s own cross-reference to its 11 February, which is the day this corpus keeps that Blaise on; a man who gave him his last communion is his story and not furniture. NO OTHER `related` ROW: the four companions are already here. HIS PRAYER IS NOT IN `hymns`: «Од светог Евстратија остала је красна молитва која се чита на суботној полуноћници: Величаја величају тја Господи» — a prayer read at the Saturday midnight office, of which the book prints the first words only. BRIEF-SERBIAN §3 takes no hymn from this source, and a prayer is not a troparion or a kontakion; it is named in the life. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Statornicia purtătorilor de biruinţă, cei cinci la număr: Sfinţii Mari Mucenici Eustratie şi Auxentie împreună cu ceilalţi luptători, înfruntând cu îndrăzneală focul şi celelalte chinuri, au primit de la Hristos cununile măririi; Căruia se şi roagă, să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mari Mucenici Eustratie, Auxentie, Evghenie, Mardarie și Orest (one hymn printed for the five together)

english.text: The steadfastness of the victory-bearers, five in number — the holy great martyrs Eustratius and Auxentius together with the rest of the contenders — boldly facing the fire and the other torments, received from Christ the crowns of glory; and to him they pray, that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἡ πενταυγὴς τῶν ἀθλοφόρων χορεία, τῇ τῶν ἀγώνων νοητῇ δαδουχίᾳ, τὴν οἰκουμένην ἅπασαν αὐγάζει νοητῶς· ὁ σοφὸς Εὐστράτιος, σὺν Αὐξεντίῳ τῷ θείῳ, Ὀρέστης καὶ Μαρδάριος καὶ Εὐγένιος ἅμα, οὗς εὐφημοῦντες εἴπωμεν πιστοί· χαίροις μαρτύρων πεντάριθμε σύλλογε.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of the five martyrs. It names all five, so it is the company's own service and is taken into each of the five folders.

english.text: The fivefold-shining choir of the prize-winners lights the whole inhabited world with the spiritual torch of their contests: the wise Eustratius with the divine Auxentius, Orestes and Mardarius and Eugene together. Praising them, let us the faithful say: Rejoice, O five-numbered company of martyrs.

hymns.text: Φωστὴρ ἐφάνης λαμπρότατος Χριστοκήρυξ, τοῖς ἐν σκότει τῆς ἀγνωσίας καθημένοις· πίστιν ὡς δόρυ δὲ περιθέμενος, τῶν δυσμενῶν τὰ θράση, οὐκ ἐπτοήθης Εὐστράτιε, Ῥητόρων ὑπάρχων εὐγλωττότερος.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὴν ἐν πρεσβείαις, on the page of the five martyrs. It names Eustratius alone, so it is taken into his folder only and not into his companions'.

english.text: Thou didst appear a most radiant light, a herald of Christ, to those sitting in the darkness of ignorance; and girding faith about thee as a spear, thou wast not dismayed at the insolence of the enemy, O Eustratius, who wast more eloquent than the orators.
